plan.purpose: Bounded training-only contact-planned demonstrations on new states, after terminal-grip development. No policy/formal/continuous acceptance
plan.directions: -1 for even blocks of7, +1 for odd blocks of7
plan.execution: For each fixed state: one independently executed real grasp prefix for four isolated points+normals/fixed-center IK fits. Then up to3 separately executed, signature-identical prefixes plus7s continuations using the fixed deltas. Preserve original controller, randomized physical model, observation history and all native gates. No live state injection, velocity clearing or model editing
plan.failures: Record prefix failures, missing anchors, infeasible knots, hard aborts and native failures; do not resample, replace, retry or extend. Expected planning failures skip that state's allocated variants. Stop on unexpected exceptions or mutated live state
plan.dataset: All outcomes retained. Only full140-tick native successes with original command limits become training examples, using the recorded296 observable inputs and16 actions. No contacts/truth as actor input. Training selection is not an independent success-rate estimate
plan.next_stage: Admission permits one separately registered finite actor-only imitation pilot; no automatic PPO, formal test or hardware action

audit.limitation: Recomputes20Hz windows and checks recorded cumulative2ms peaks; no new simulation or hardware
